Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Developer to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable backend systems that power Standard Chartered’ s digital banking platform. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, build platform 0-1, and contribute to architectural decisions that with major business impact to our global financial market business.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using modern technologies
  • Implement microservices architecture patterns and distributed system design principles
  • Ensure system reliability, performance, and security across all backend services
  • Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Development & Implementation

  • Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
  • Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
  • Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with front-end developers, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
  • Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
  • Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
  • Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required

Skills And Experience

  • Java (Spring Boot)
  • Relational DB
  • MQ
  • Logging, Monitoring and Alerts
  • Design Pattern
  • API

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • 3-8 years of experience in backend development with strong Java expertise
  • Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
  • Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
  • Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)

Professional Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking capabilities
  • Experience working in agile development environments
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex technical concepts

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Banking or financial services domain knowledge advantageous

Preferred Requirements

  • Knowledge of performance optimization and system scalability techniques
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack)

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Position Purpose

Compliance Officer-Trading is responsible for the compliance management of the Company's Principal Trading Department under the guidance and supervision of the Compliance Department.

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

Compliance Management Aspects

  • Assist the Head of Trading Department to fulfill his compliance responsibilities; and provide reasonable assurance on the compliance of the Trading operations/activities with applicable laws and regulations;
  • As a person of contact, be responsible for contacting the Compliance Department on the compliance work of the Trading Department and cooperating to implement the relevant tasks arranged and deployed by the Compliance Department;
  • Carry out laws & regulations watch to ensure the Trading Department kept abreast of the latest changes of relevant laws, regulations and regulatory requirement;
  • Within Trading, ensure consistency of group policies and methodologies by cascading them down to the relevant stakeholders subject to local regulatory framework;
  • Establish appropriate governance to manage risk of non-compliance: Coordinating with Regional GM Compliance Officers, and Leveraging Domains (including but not limited to Market Integrity, Protection of Interests of Client) Compliance Officers expertise;
  • Support the effective implementation of associated Trading control set-ups; and follow effective implementation of compliance-related IT tools in his/her scope of responsibilities;
  • Provide advisory to the Head and other staff of the Trading Department on compliance matters of Trading business, and provide preliminary opinions on matters in terms of compliance advisory and compliance review to be submitted by the Trading Department to the Compliance Department;
  • Submit compliance reports to the Compliance Department regularly or irregularly according to the requirements of the company's relevant procedures;
  • Propose compliance self-inspection suggestions to the Head of Trading Department; report any compliance and/or reputational risks or violations of laws and regulations in the Trading Department to the Head of Trading Department and the Compliance Department, and put forward relevant compliance remediation proposals;
  • Supervise and inspect the compliance of employees' practice conduct/behavior in the Trading Department;
  • Assist the Head of Trading Department to carry out compliance publicity and training of the Trading Department and build the compliance culture;
  • Cooperate to complete the inspection, investigation or other regulatory requirements on the Trading business imposed by regulators;
  • Complete other compliance tasks assigned by the Compliance Department or the Head of Trading Department.

Permanent Control Aspects

  • Direct contribution to BNPP operational permanent control framework.
  • Contribute to the implementation of operational permanent control policies and procedures in day-to-day business activities, such as Control Plan
  • Comply with regulatory requirements and internal guidelines
  • Contribute to the reporting of all incidents according to the Incident Management System
  • Ensure audit recommendations are resolved within the specific timeline.

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

Technical

  • Possess professional knowledge and skills suitable for performing the above-mentioned compliance management responsibilities.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Power BI, as well as using tools for presentation to stakeholders or senior management
  • Strong communication skills in written and spoken Chinese and English
  • Familiarity with the regulatory landscape in China
  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Ability to identify key risk and contribute to the control framework for a wide variety of situations with the ability to act autonomously
  • Ability to form and articulate an informed position through structured thinking, problem solving and prioritisation
  • Tact and ability to interact with staff and management at all levels in order to achieve mutually acceptable resolution of incidents

Behavioural

  • Resourceful and proactive to reach out to relevant stakeholders or peers to develop action plans to resolve issues within a cross-functional matrix environment
  • Self-motivated, decisive with the ability to adapt to change and competing demands with pressing deadlines for multiple tasks
  • High ethical standard

Specific Qualifications (if Required)

  • Securities practitioner qualification is a must
  • Bachelor’s Degree in appropriate field of study or equivalent work experience
  • More than 3 years working experience in securities, finance, law, accounting, information technology and other related fields.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

The Group AI Platform team sits within CTO Platforms, part of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO). We build shared AI foundations that enable teams across the Bank to deliver AI solutions faster, more safely and at scale.

Our platform provides a “paved road” for AI delivery, bringing together seamless access to AI models and infrastructure, a consistent Agent HUB to build, deploy and manage production-ready AI agents, reusable AI capabilities (such as knowledge management and document intelligence), and built-in controls including guardrails, evaluation and monitoring to support responsible adoption.

We’re a global team with an established footprint across Asia (Hong Kong, Mainland China, India) and Europe (Poland, UK), and we continue to expand to support delivery across regions. Joining the team means working at the centre of HSBC’s AI enablement—partnering with multiple lines of business and functions across regions to turn AI capabilities into reliable, repeatable services that deliver measurable business value.Demonstrates an AI-native mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to improve productivity, quality, and decision-making.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering (Group AI Platform SME)

Business:CTO Platforms (AI Platform)

Job ID：55011

 Location: Shenzhen / Guangzhou

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver difficult engineering problems across core AI platform domains, including AI gateway capabilities, security guardrails, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic platform services.
  • Design and implement production-grade services in Go (Golang), with strong focus on concurrency, latency, throughput, fault tolerance and maintainability.
  • Make sound technical decisions in areas such as service boundaries, interface design, failure handling, observability, rollout safety and long-term operability.
  • Drive implementation quality through disciplined engineering practices, including code review, automated testing, performance validation, secure software design and clear technical documentation.
  • Convert loosely defined requirements or emerging platform needs into clear designs, delivery slices and durable technical solutions.
  • Work closely with principal engineers and peer engineers to challenge assumptions, refine designs and improve the overall quality of platform architecture and execution.
  • Contribute as a high-trust individual contributor who raises standards through technical depth, consistent delivery, practical mentoring and example-setting rather than formal line management.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating gateway platforms, service control planes or application programming interface (API) mediation layers in complex enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with security controls for AI systems, including policy enforcement, access control, auditability, model governance and runtime guardrails.
  • Practical understanding of retrieval-augmented generation architectures, including ingestion pipelines, embeddings, retrieval strategies, ranking and evaluation of answer quality.
  • Experience with agentic systems or platforms used to build, orchestrate and govern production-ready AI agents.
  • Working knowledge of Golang and/or Python for platform tooling, integration, experimentation or adjacent service development.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native production systems, including deployment patterns, networking, scaling, resilience and operational troubleshooting.
  • Track record of improving engineering organisations through design reviews, technical standards, shared frameworks or uplift of peer engineering capability.

About HSBC Technology China

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. /51/LP/WX

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our

customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
  • Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
  • Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
  • Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Qualifications

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
  • Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
  • Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
  • High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
  • Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
  • Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  • Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in Mandarin and English

/NA

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering. (Agent Hub UI UX Tech Lead)

Business:CTO Platform

Location: Guangzhou/Xian

Job ID：55594

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end UX: discovery, user flows, IA, wireframes, prototyping, usability testing
  • Deliver polished UI: responsive layouts, interaction design, visual hierarchy, micro-interactions
  • Apply accessibility standards, inclusive design, content and contrast best practice
  • Partner with Product and Engineering: translate requirements into build-ready designs and acceptance criteria
  • Contribute to UI implementation: collaborate on component libraries/design systems; code UI where required (e.g., React/CSS)
  • Measure and improve outcomes: analytics-informed iteration, experiment support, continuous optimisation
  • Provide senior leadership: mentor peers, run critiques/workshops, drive consistency and quality across products

Requirements

  • 6+ years’ experience in UX/UI design, product design, design engineering, or similar roles.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end work (discovery → design → delivery) with measurable outcomes.
  • Strong in interaction design, visual design, and designing complex journeys (forms, onboarding, dashboards, transactional flows).
  • Strong proficiency with design tools (Figma preferred) and collaborative workflows.
  • Solid understanding of front-end constraints and modern UI implementation approaches (even if you’re not hands-on coding daily).
  • Practical experience designing for accessibility and inclusive design.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; able to influence decisions with evidence.

/51/LP/WX

Job Summary

This role will act as a key person in Finance team, as BU controller of trading and brokerage business, calculating risk control ratio, preparing Regulatory and Group reports etc.

Key Responsibilities

Business

  • Work as BU controller for trading and brokerage business
  • Responsible for calculation of risk control ratio
  • Responsible for certain financial statements and regulatory reporting
  • Support external and internal audit
  • Other work assigned (tax, Account payable, financial system management, etc.)

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters

Skills And Experience

  • Accounting
  • Financial analysis
  • Financial and accounting systems
  • Risk indicator management

Qualifications

  • SAC Membership/Qualification

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4467508683.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Customer sales and service

职责范围：

客户销售与服务

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.
  • Deliver allocated performance targets for various product VSs;
  • Maintain relationship with customers and deliver superior customer service to ensure customers’ needs are met;
  • Enhance bank-customer relationships by expanding existing customers’ portfolio holdings;
  • Actively participate in Priority Banking / other Bank’s marketing and promotional activities to acquire NTB customers, as well as cross-selling to existing customers;
  • Proactively engage with Personal Clients hidden affluent and advise to approach bank with complex investment needs;
  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
  • Ensure compliance of Management Manual, Operating Manuals and Bank’s laid down knowledge of the various products offered by all departments;
  • Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures;
  • Keep updated on the events in the financial industry;
  • Participate actively in training programs, meetings, briefings organized by the bank and ensure skills & knowledge acquired is applied to daily work;
  • Ensure timeliness & managing customer’s complaint;

主要工作职责/挑战：

  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
  • 实现领导安排的各个产品的业绩指标；
  • 维护与客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足客户需求；
  • 通过扩大现有客户的投资组合加强客户与我行的关系；
  • 积极参与优先理财/其它银行营销项目，以获取新客户。另外，向现有客户进行交叉销售；
  • 主动发现具有“优先理财”资质的个人理财客户, 并发掘其投资理财需求；
  • 负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
  • 遵循银行的管理手册，操作手册和所有部门相关产品的既定政策；
  • 学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
  • 保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
  • 积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
  • 确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for [Liquidity] risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Financial skills
  • Analytical skills

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • Full time Bachelor’s degree, or AMAC Fund Qualification Certificate Holder.
  • 1 year or above working experience in financial industry, acting in good faith and professional ethics. Have a good command of knowledge about wealth management sales activities related regulations
  • Sound knowledge of financial products and services and banking procedures, equities markets, unit trusts and other personal investment services are preferred.
  • Good investment counseling and analytical skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, ability to deal with all levels of people, often in complex and difficult situations.
  • Team player who shows initiative and assertiveness.
  • Self-motivator who is keen to upgrade, improve personal knowledge and skills to meet job requirements.
  • Good command of both spoken and written English and Mandarin

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Principal Responsibilities

Software engineering and delivery

  • Analyze requirements and translate them into robust technical designs and implementation plans.
  • Develop, enhance and maintain applications using Java, Spring/Spring Boot and RESTful APIs.
  • Contribute to solution design, technical estimates, implementation, testing and release activities.
  • Produce clean, maintainable and reusable code in line with HSBC engineering standards and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to improve quality and consistency.
  • Work with technical leads, analysts and Product Owners to clarify requirements, acceptance criteria and delivery expectations.
  • Support the delivery of features across development, system integration testing, user acceptance testing and production release.

Production support and operational readiness

  • Participate in application releases, code promotions and post-release stabilization.
  • Provide L3 production support, investigate incidents and identify effective short- and long-term solutions.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to prevent recurrence.
  • Support operational handover by preparing technical documentation, support procedures and release evidence.
  • Contribute to service stability, performance, resilience and continuous improvement.
  • Agile team contribution
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, reviews and retrospectives.
  • Work collaboratively with engineers, analysts and partner IT teams to remove technical blockers and meet sprint commitments.
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to less experienced team members.
  • Help improve development practices, engineering quality, automation and team throughput.
  • Raise delivery risks, dependencies and issues promptly to the technical lead or delivery manager.

Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration

  • Work effectively with technical leads, Product Owners, business analysts and partner IT teams.
  • Support the clarification of business requirements without owning overall business prioritization or project governance.

Documentation, compliance and audit readiness

  • Maintain accurate technical, application and release documentation.
  • Provide evidence and technical information for audit, risk, control and regulatory activities.
  • Follow HSBC security, architecture, engineering, change and operational procedures.
  • Ensure deliverables meet required control, quality and documentation standards.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years’ hands-on software engineering experience in Java-based environments.
  • Strong experience with Java, Spring/Spring Boot and RESTful API development.
  • Strong experience with relational databases, SQL and stored procedures; Oracle or PostgreSQL experience is preferred.
  • Experience with software development lifecycle activities, including design, coding, testing, release and production support.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues independently.
  • Good understanding of secure coding, testing discipline, code review and production readiness.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, with fluent spoken English and professional business writing.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in an Agile, multi-team and geographically distributed environment.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering(AI Research Lead).

Business:AI Platforms

Job ID：63381

Why join us?

The Group AI Platform team sits within CTO Platforms, part of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO). We build shared AI foundations that enable teams across the Bank to deliver AI solutions faster, more safely and at scale.

Our platform provides a “paved road” for AI delivery, bringing together seamless access to AI models and infrastructure, a consistent Agent HUB to build, deploy and manage production-ready AI agents, reusable AI capabilities (such as knowledge management and document intelligence), and built-in controls including guardrails, evaluation and monitoring to support responsible adoption.

We’re a global team with an established footprint across Asia (Hong Kong, Mainland China, India) and Europe (Poland, UK), and we continue to expand to support delivery across regions. Joining the team means working at the centre of HSBC’s AI enablement—partnering with multiple lines of business and functions across regions to turn AI capabilities into reliable, repeatable services that deliver measurable business value.

The Opportunity

This role is a strategic technical leader responsible for setting the AI research agenda, leading the development of advanced models and methods, and translating research into practical business value. The role combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence with strong people leadership, stakeholder engagement and responsible innovation.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Set the AI research vision and roadmap in line with business priorities.
  • Lead research into advanced AI, machine learning and generative AI methods.
  • Translate research outcomes into secure, scalable and production-ready solutions.
  • Manage, mentor and grow a high-performing team of AI researchers and engineers.
  • Collaborate with product, technology, risk, legal and data stakeholders.
  • Establish robust standards for model quality, explainability, fairness and governance.
  • Publish findings, protect intellectual property and represent the organisation externally.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • Have very good track record of hands-on coding and project delivery
  • Strong education and technical background or research capabilities
  • Demonstrate great sense and understanding of AI industry trends and updates
  • Willing to work at high pace to conduct investigations and generate reports
  • Ability to translate research into scalable business solutions
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and strategic thinking

You’ll achieve more at HSBC

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

The Banker is a senior level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Banker also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Leverage past investment banking or related experience to enhance Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) execution and capital raising capabilities and contribute to building Citi's franchise
  • Meet revenue and other financial goals by establishing and maintaining a pipeline of episodic deals
  • Ensure that proposed client solutions meet or exceed internal risk and return standards, including stringent ethical standards,
  • Anticipate future changes in the marketplace
  • Identify and anticipate all types of risks (e.g. industry, portfolio, diversification, sovereign, commercial, currency, etc.)
  • Serve as a mentor to junior Bankers, execute staffing models that support business needs and career trajectories for junior staff
  • Build client relationships by providing sophisticated financial solutions tailored to the clients’ needs and acting as a content provider on market trends
  • Serve as the expert on regulatory, financial and complex strategic issues relating to corporate finance transactions
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in people management
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or closely related areas of Business Administration preferred
  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred
  • Experience working in an investment banking institution(s)
  • Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  • Demonstrated ability to remain unbiased in a diverse working environment
  • Series 79 and 63 licenses

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  • Master’s degree preferred
  • Engage in the buildout of China equity capital markets team and design internal deal process, policy and procedures
  • Lead origination and execution of global ECM transactions with a strong focus on China A-share transactions Lead and manage end-to-end execution of ECM transactions including A-share IPOs, follow-on offerings, rights issues, convertible bonds, and equity-linked products on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SZSE), and STAR Market (科创板)
  • Drive origination of new ECM mandates through proactive client engagement, sector expertise, and market intelligence
  • Coordinate cross-border equity transactions including H-share listings, A+H dual listings, and HKEX IPOs for China-based issuers
  • Oversee preparation of prospectuses, offering memoranda, regulatory filings, and investor marketing materials to the highest standard of accuracy and compliance
  • 10+ years of relevant ECM origination and execution experience with a deep understanding of China A-share market as well as good knowledge of global capital markets
  • Solid understanding of local financial markets and ECM product knowledge
  • Preferably also equipped with DCM product knowledge
  • Familiarity with CSRC/Exchanges/SAC rules
  • Experience of covering local institutional investors
  • Secure and maintain all necessary CSRC licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out securities and other regulated activities
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English
  • Preference for HK SFC Type 6 licenses / qualifications

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist (Frontend Engineering).

Business: CTO AI Platforms

Job ID：65894

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end frontend delivery, from requirements clarification and technical solution design through implementation, testing, release, and production support.
  • Design and continuously evolve the frontend architecture and shared foundational capabilities of the AI Platform Portal, balancing consistency, extensibility, maintainability, and delivery efficiency.
  • Build high-quality product workflows for platform capabilities such as model services, RAG, Agents, and MCP, including backend API integration and asynchronous or streaming interactions where needed.
  • Align frontend interfaces, API contracts, and integration plans with backend, AI, and platform teams, identifying dependencies and risks early.
  • Establish and continuously improve frontend engineering practices, including component design, code reviews, automated testing, accessibility, and release quality.
  • Diagnose and improve user-perceived performance, reliability, and usability; provide appropriate loading, empty, error, and recovery states, and use telemetry and production feedback to drive improvements.
  • Work with product and design teams to refine requirements and deliver accessible, responsive experiences across supported browsers and devices.
  • Share technical knowledge and mentor teammates to improve frontend implementation quality and team effectiveness.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • 6+ years of frontend engineering experience, with a strong track record of delivering and maintaining production-grade web applications.
  • Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript, including component architecture, Hooks, reusable design patterns, and performance-conscious rendering.
  • Experience designing frontend architectures that are scalable and maintainable for the needs of the product; experience designing or implementing micro-frontend architectures.
  • Proficient with frontend build and development tools such as Vite or Webpack, as well as package management, linting, formatting, and CI workflows.
  • Experience analyzing and optimizing frontend performance, including using browser performance tools to identify issues and optimize rendering, asset loading, and bundle size.
  • Experience managing client-side state and server-side data, with familiarity with tools such as Redux Toolkit, Zustand, and React Query.
  • Strong understanding of modern JavaScript, browser behavior, semantic HTML, CSS, responsive layouts, and accessibility fundamentals.
  • Experience integrating frontend applications with REST or GraphQL APIs, with the ability to handle asynchronous operations, authentication flows, network issues, and service failures reliably.
  • Solid testing experience across unit/component and end-to-end levels; familiarity with tools such as Jest or Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
  • Ability to own complex work independently, make sound technical trade-offs, communicate risks proactively, and collaborate effectively with product, design, and engineering teams.
  • Good English communication skills for day-to-day cross-functional collaboration.

/51/LP/WX

Global Risk and Compliance

Risk and Compliance is a global function that brings together all aspects of regulatory and financial crime risk management. Acting as risk stewards, and incorporating a range of specialist teams, we work together with the business and leverage advanced technology to help HSBC navigate a complex regulatory landscape and embed a sustainable approach to compliance risk management that supports safe growth and ensures fair outcomes for clients. Compliance aspires to continuously raise the bar and set leading standards across the industry to help HSBC safeguard its customers and the communities within which it operates.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

The role is set to fulfil regulatory requirements on Fraud Risk Steward responsibility, as well as Criminal Case Prevention.

The role holder is responsible for

  • supporting Head of Criminal Case Prevention and Fraud Management to implement the HBCN Fraud Risk Management and Criminal Case Prevention framework (at both headquarter and branch levels) to ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, internal codes and policies and good market practices.
  • supporting to guide GB/GIs to embed Global FC Fraud policy and risk management framework, including gap analysis, detection mechanism enhancement, process optimization, employee/non-employee vetting, etc.
  • supporting GB/GIs in setting external/internal fraud risk appetite and control mechanism.
  • providing internal fraud / external fraud policy guidance, definition and interpretation assistance; and preforming oversight activities, as well as consulting on dispensation requests
  • advising and challenging the 1LOD on all aspects of material internal and external Fraud Risk events.
  • Observing the latest regulatory requirements and fraud modes operandi, and designing the Fraud Risk/Criminal Case Prevention training material.
  • Promoting process simplification during external fraud control review and assessment.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Good understanding of regulatory environment, expectations and relevant regulations on Criminal Case Prevention.
  • Banking experience required with knowledge of banking systems, products and processes.
  • Sound knowledge of risk management and internal control framework.
  • Knowledge and awareness of current and ever changing Criminal Case trends and fraud trends.
  • Strong skills to handle multiple tasks in parallel.
  • Background of fraud risk management a plus.
  • Good understanding of lending facilities. Credit or business background a plus.
  • Good communication skills in English and Mandarin.
  • Good team work spirit and could work under pressure.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
